name: k8gb-zero-downtime-edge-dns-provider-migration
instr:
k8gb cannot currently migrate ZoneDelegation between ExternalDNS and Infoblox without downtime. Implement durable coexistence, equivalence checks, cutover, rollback, and cleanup. Coordinate only requested unfinished migrations. Otherwise preserve ordinary reconciliation, including CoreDNS, status, provider-save sequencing, and EmptyDNS behavior.

Every `Provider`, identified by `ProviderName`, must preserve save and finalization semantics and support every `MigrationOutcome`. ExternalDNS must verify the complete delegation projection and remove staged and authoritative endpoints independently. Infoblox must verify normalized nameservers in the configured view, activate the observed WAPI reference, and compensate only migration-created writes. EmptyDNS continues accepting ordinary delegation saves, but migration preparation returns `ErrMigrationUnsupported`, exactly `DNS provider migration unsupported`, and observation never reports external equivalence or activation. Unknown `ProviderFactory.ProviderByName` identities return `ErrUnknownProvider`, exactly `unknown DNS provider`, without fallback. Migration selection supplies distinct source and target instances; ordinary selection stays unchanged. `MigrationCoordinator` and `NewMigrationCoordinator` must advance at most one durable phase per reconcile from fresh observations, make completed effects idempotent, and keep failures retryable.
